A cylindrical spacecraft module with solar panels floating in orbit above the blue Earth, black starry space filling the whole picture to every edge, full-bleed painting with no white margins or border.

Children's encyclopedia illustration, painterly gouache style, warm natural light, historically accurate details, no text, no letters, no logos, landscape 4:3. The Colossus of Rhodes as historians imagine it: a giant nude bronze statue of the Greek sun god Helios with a crown of sun rays, one hand shading his eyes, standing on a tall white marble pedestal on the harbour mole of ancient Rhodes, Greek galleys sailing past. Ancient Greek style, no torch, no tablet.

India, 1930, seen from behind: a thin elderly bald man in a white homespun cotton cloth and shawl walks barefoot with a long wooden staff along a dusty road towards the sea, followed by a long line of people dressed in white. We see only his back and the road ahead, palm trees and the shining sea on the horizon.

Children's encyclopedia illustration, painterly gouache style, muted winter light, no text, no letters, no logos, landscape 4:3. Moscow in the 1930s, seen from behind: a man in a plain grey-brown high-collared military tunic stands at a tall window of a dark wood-panelled office with maps on the desk, looking out at the snowy red brick Kremlin towers and smoking factory chimneys in the distance. Only his back and shoulders are visible.

Children's encyclopedia illustration, painterly gouache style, warm natural light, no text, no letters, no logos, landscape 4:3. Beijing, October 1949, seen from behind: a man in a plain grey buttoned tunic suit stands at the stone balustrade on top of a traditional red gate with yellow tiled roofs, looking down at a huge square full of people and red flags without any writing. Only his back is visible.
